verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a password manager, not an AI agent or assistant host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role that belongs to agentic products, so this axis is a category error here. Nothing in the evidence shows Proton Pass shipping an AI assistant or any MCP client capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
